_schema.id: string  | SLUG — kebab-case, unique across all certs. Seeder converts to UUID v5. e.g. 'aws-saa', 'az-900'
_schema.title: string  | Full certification name. Must be unique per vendor+level combination.
_schema.description: string  | One-paragraph summary of what the cert validates.
_schema.examCode: string  | Official exam code from the vendor. e.g. 'SAA-C03', 'AZ-900'
_schema.url: string  | Canonical URL to the vendor's certification page.
_schema.iconUrl: string  | Path to the SVG icon served from /public/icons/
